caption_en: Horizontal and vertical position errors of OiSAM-FGO, TC-FGO and GNC-FGO during nominal walking, large body motion and single-antenna obstruction, evaluated at the GNSS1 antenna. Curves break across missing outputs and OiSAM-FGO segment boundaries. Horizontal errors use logarithmic axes; vertical errors use a symmetric logarithmic scale with a linear region near zero. OiSAM uses reinitialization at recorded IMU gaps, with initialization-only states excluded. OiSAM uses RTK position and IMU, TC-FGO uses raw code and adapted attitude/velocity inputs, and GNC-FGO uses raw code and Doppler; input information is not identical.
caption_zh: 常规行走、大幅机身运动和单侧天线遮挡实验中，OiSAM-FGO、TC-FGO和GNC-FGO在GNSS1天线位置上的水平与高程误差。缺测和OiSAM-FGO分段边界处断线。水平误差用对数尺度，高程误差用零附近保持线性的对称对数尺度。 OiSAM在实测IMU缺口处重新初始化，仅初始化的状态不计入曲线。OiSAM使用RTK位置与IMU，TC-FGO使用原始码及适配姿态/速度输入，GNC-FGO使用原始码和Doppler；三条路线的输入信息不同。
meaning_zh: 把三种GNSS信息处理路线的误差变化放到同一场景时钟中，呈现持续误差和局部异常，而不是只给一个整段RMSE。

technical_notes.output_point: All plotted positions use the GNSS1 antenna point; Oi uses its own attitude for point transport.
technical_notes.supports: Primary dynamic-only own supports Oi275/267/370, Wen/GNC274/270/377 out of275/271/378; every prior-only state excluded and missing state unconnected.
technical_notes.inputs: Oi:RTK+IMU with1/3/7 fixed input blocks; TC-FGO:raw code+AHRS/IMU; GNC-FGO:raw code+Doppler. These method conditions belong in the comparison table.
technical_notes.scales: Horizontal logarithmic; signed vertical symmetric-log with linear region±0.1m. All observed error scales retained.
technical_notes.source_identity: Three new segmented Oi runs and six reused original batch runs. Oi3286s usable-nonconverged output retained.
technical_notes.display: All saved valid dynamic states plotted without smoothing or downsampling; gaps and block boundaries break curves.
